meta.description: Build publication-grade Mermaid diagrams with consistent styling and SVG-first export for manuscript assets.

copy.tagline: 生成出版级 Mermaid 图表并导出 SVG
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在学术稿件或技术文档中嵌入风格统一的图表。
copy.tagline_en: Generate publication-grade Mermaid diagrams with SVG export
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need consistent, high-quality diagrams for academic papers or technical docs.

howto.what: Claude 会帮你生成排版一致、适合发表的 Mermaid 图表，并优先输出 SVG 格式，方便直接用于论文或稿件。
howto.when: 当你要求绘制架构图、流程图或方法图，或者提到“让这个 mermaid 看起来专业”、“导出 mermaid 为 svg”时触发。

say.text: 帮我画一个从问题到发表的流程图，用 Mermaid。
say.note: Claude 会生成一个带方向箭头的 Mermaid 图表。

say.text: 把这个 Mermaid 图改成专业风格并导出为 SVG。
say.note: Claude 会调整样式并输出 SVG 格式。

howto.what_en: Claude will help you create publication-grade Mermaid diagrams with consistent styling, prioritizing SVG export for manuscript use.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to create architecture, workflow, or methods diagrams, or mention phrases like "make this mermaid look professional" or "export mermaid to svg".

say_en.text: Draw a flowchart from question to publication using Mermaid.
say_en.note: Claude will generate a Mermaid diagram with directional flow.

say_en.text: Make this Mermaid diagram professional and export as SVG.
say_en.note: Claude will restyle and output SVG format.
